title: Recasting the Monthly Payment after a Curtailment — Rural Home Loans Terms
content:
**Terms.** On a Rural Home Loans product on which recast is offered, the member may ask, through a recast request, to recast the monthly payment after a single curtailment of at least the product's recast minimum curtailment. A recast may be made only while the loan is in active status. No payment may be past due. The new monthly payment amortises the principal balance after the curtailment over the months remaining to the unchanged maturity date at the current note rate, rounded to cents, effective with the next payment due date, and the product's recast fee is assessed. Adjustable products are re-amortised at their change dates instead and are never recast.

## Conditions at a glance

| Condition | Source of the fact |
|---|---|
| Product offers recast | the product's terms |
| A single curtailment of at least the minimum | the loan's payment history |
| Loan in active status | the loan record's status, read before the recast |
| No payment past due | the loan's monthly bills |
| A recast request | the member's request |

## Effect

The maturity date and the note rate do not change; the new payment is the level payment on the principal after the curtailment over the remaining months, rounded to cents, from the next payment due date; the recast fee is assessed.

## Points of judgement

- Two curtailments of 6000.00 USD each do not meet a minimum of 10000.00 USD; the test is a single curtailment.
- A loan in forbearance or nonaccrual status is not in active status and is not recast.
- The Country Home 5/6 Adjustable and Country Home 7/6 Adjustable are never recast.
